concerns.text: Task T005a implements a 'Human Annotation Interface' via Streamlit or manual JSONL entry. This task lacks a mechanism to satisfy Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires results to be reproducible on a fresh runner. There is no task to generate or load a deterministic 'pre-recorded annotation artifact' to replace the manual step in CI, leaving FR-001 (labeled dataset) unimplementable in an automated pipeline.

Task T019a (generate_manifest) depends on T044 (power_analysis) for sample size. T044 is defined to 'log a warning but proceed' if the dataset is too small, potentially leaving the required sample size undefined. T019a has no fallback logic to handle a missing or invalid sample size, creating a deadlock for FR-004 (stratified random sample) if the dataset is insufficient.

Task T029h implements a 'Paired t-test' or 'Wilcoxon signed-rank test' on 'Time-to-Pivot' including censored rows. This contradicts SC-001 and T029a which mandate 'Tobit Regression' for censored data. There is no task to perform the required Tobit regression on the censored data, leaving SC-001 (Time-to-Pivot difference measurement) unfulfilled by the current task set.

Task T029d (Aggregate Failure Proportions) depends on T027b and T027c. T027b explicitly excludes 'Missing Ground Truth' cases, while T029d is required to calculate proportions against the 'total' (including missing). There is no task to aggregate the excluded counts from T027c into the denominator for T029d, creating a logic gap for SC-004 (proportion of failed pivots).

Task T007c (Resource Watchdog) includes logic to reduce dataset size if a model exceeds RAM. Task T043 (Quantization Verification) requires loading the *full* model to verify INT4 status. If the full model fails to load (as T007c anticipates), T043 will fail, blocking the pipeline. There is no task to reconcile this conflict or provide a fallback path for T043 when the full model is intractable.

Task T060 (Orchestration Script) is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked) but is listed as a dependency for the pipeline's execution flow. While not a missing FR/SC, the lack of a defined entry point for the 'tasked' stage implementation creates ambiguity in the execution plan.
